transcript.text: Mr. Lincoln. Representative Douglas has brought formal charges that you voted in favor of the Sangamon County land grant while simultaneously representing the principal beneficiary of that grant in your law practice. The ethics of this chamber require that no member profit from legislation he has a hand in passing. You are well-regarded here, sir, but I must hear your account. Explain yourself.

While it is true that I did represent a client with an interest in the Sangamon County land grant, I assure you that my decision to support the grant was based solely on its merits and benefits to the community at large. My vote was made in the best interests of the people I serve, not for personal gain or to benefit any individual client.

I take seriously the ethical standards that govern our actions as legislators, and I have always strived to uphold the highest level of integrity in my public service. If there are any doubts about the propriety of my actions, I am more than willing to address them and provide any additional information that may be required to resolve this matter.

I trust that the members of this esteemed chamber will consider my explanation with fairness and impartiality, and I am confident that the truth will prevail in due course. Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to clarify this situation.
